question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who is a lover of women.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Philogynist"** means a person who loves or admires women. (महिलाओं का प्रेमी)

 
 
• **Example: **He was known as a **philogynist** who always supported women's rights and initiatives.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Philologist **(भाषाशास्त्री): A person who studies language in written historical sources; a linguist.

 
 
• **Example:** As a philologist, she was deeply interested in the origins and evolution of languages.
 
 
 
• **Monogamist **(एकपत्नीवादी): A person who is married to one person at a time.
 
 
• **Example: **He is a monogamist, devoted entirely to his spouse.
 
 
 
• **Misogynist **(स्त्रीद्वेषी): A person who dislikes, despises, or is strongly prejudiced against women.
 
 
• **Example:** The character in the novel is a misogynist who shows contempt towards women.
 
 

47:Tc14,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
